create_put_model: create an mjx.Model from a mujoco.MjModel on a specified device and implementation
create_make_data: allocate and initialize an mjx.Data object for a given mjx.Model on a specified device
create_put_data: put a mujoco.MjData onto a device resulting in an mjx.Data with specified implementation
create_get_data: get mjx.Data from a device resulting in a mujoco.MjData or list of MjData objects
create_set_state: set state in mjx.Data from a flat array using a state spec bitmask
